questions.prompt: Which hand should isolate a single limper from the button?
questions.explanation: Isolate hands that are ahead of a limp and play well heads-up. Trash still folds.

questions.prompt: No one has opened. Two players limp. You are in the small blind with KK. Clear mistake?

choices.text: Completing the small blind to trap
Raising and continuing versus a caller
Raising bigger than a no-limper open

questions.explanation: Completing kings lets the big blind see a cheap flop. Raise.

choices.text: A premium that must be folded to.
A weaker, capped range you can attack with a raise.
The same as an under-the-gun open.

questions.explanation: Limpers are weighted toward hands that did not want to raise. Punish them with position and size.

questions.prompt: You want to isolate, and three players have limped. Compared with zero limpers, your raise should be…

choices.text: An under-raise, which is legal in no-limit
Larger, because there is more dead money

questions.explanation: More limpers means more money to deny and more players to fold.
